title: Finite Configurations Cannot Generate a Constant Trace in Rule 30
summary: For every right half we determine the unique left half whose Rule 30 central trace is constant: an alternating tail selected by the leading one of the right half when the initial center is 0, and a single universal checkerboard when it is 1. Every nonzero member of either fiber carries infinitely many ones, so the zero row is the only finite configuration with a constant trace.
